facts.text: The user is preparing for an interview for a Junior Policy assistant position at ISED (Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada).
The user wants interview questions to prepare for the Junior Policy assistant role at ISED.
The job description states that when the COVID-19 pandemic began, it highlighted the need to boost Canada's domestic biomanufacturing and life sciences industry.
The job description states that the Government of Canada is focused on building back better to protect Canadians through the current pandemic and beyond.
The job description states that the Government of Canada aims to strengthen the biomanufacturing and life sciences sector and drive economic growth.

The job description states that students would assist officials with research and analysis to support project assessments for company proposals to grow Canada's Life Sciences and Biomanufacturing Sector.
The job description states that strong research skills are an asset for the role.
The job description states that the ability to manage multiple priorities is an asset for the role.
The job description states that performing quick turn around requests is an asset for the role.
The job description states that curiosity about the biomanufacturing industry is an asset for the role.
The job description states that experience in a life sciences program is an asset for the role.
The user provided a link to the ISED biomanufacturing page: https://ised-isde.canada.ca/site/biomanufacturing/en.
